name: Densha de Deatta Marude Tenshi no Youna Chijo
original_name: 電車で出会ったまるで天使のような痴女
source:
I'm a typical salaryman.
I was on the train when something... happened.
It must have been around the afternoon.
A pretty schoolgirl with a cherubic face raised her skirt.
She showed me perfect, hairless cleft. 
If there was any question...

She said,
"Look more! Eat me with your eyes."

[From the [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ160212.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English product page of the CG Edition[/url]]
